Composer Player ActiveX API - Objects

All objects, types, and properties are described in XML format.

Name Description XML Example
Actor

A Modifiable that is graphically represented.

3D CAD actors are identified with the name extracted from the CAD file.
Modifiable

An object that has properties.

 
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"> 
  <Actor.Alpha Value="100"/>
</CLitModifiable>
PropertyMap A set of Modifiables and associated properties. 
<CLitPropertyMap>
  <CLitModifiable Name="Body01">
    <Actor.Color R="255"G="255"B="0"/>
  </CLitModifiable>
  <CLitModifiable Name="Body02">
    <Actor.Alpha Value="100"/>
  </CLitModifiable>
</CLitPropertyMap>
PropertySet A set of properties. 
<CLitPropertySet>
  <Actor.Alpha Value="0"/>
  <Actor.Color R="255" G="0" B="128"/>
</CLitPropertySet>
Root First node of the assembly structure. 
<CLitSelection Name="" Ident="-1">
  -1
</CLitSelection>
Selection A set of actors specified as Modifiable names or alphanumeric Guid strings depending on the UseGUID parameter state:
- UseGUID = 0: Returns Modifiable names in the Selection.
- UseGUID = 1: Returns GUIDs in the Selection.		 
<CLitSelection Name="">
  <CLitModifiable Name="smg_body 1"/>
  <CLitModifiable Name="smg_body 2"/>
</CLitSelection>

<CLitSelection Name="">
  8cb9b30b4874ac23#
</CLitSelection>
List

A collection of objects like “Selection Sets” or “Views".

 
<CLitList>
  <CLitSelection Name="Selection 1"/>
  <CLitSelection Name="Selection 2"/>
</CLitList>
